description: This file defines the PartitionEndpointProvider class, which provides methods for managing AWS service endpoint partitions based on regions and options. It includes functions for retrieving specific partitions, default provider initialization, and merging prefix data for endpoints.

classes.name: PartitionEndpointProvider
classes.description: Provides AWS partition endpoint management, including retrieving partitions, default provider setup, and data merging.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with a list of partitions, a default partition name, and options.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Allows the class to be called as a function to resolve a partition based on region and service.

methods.name: getPartition
methods.description: Returns the partition object that matches a given region and service.

methods.name: getPartitionByName
methods.description: Retrieves a partition by its name.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default provider instance with data loaded from JSON files and options.

methods.name: mergePrefixData
methods.description: Merges endpoint prefix data into partitions for services, using environment search functions.
